title: Wolfbox Electric Air Duster MF50 $38.15, DF60 $36.03, MF70 $45.22, DF100 $58.39, DF200 $75.99 Delivered @ Wolfbox eBay
body:
Deal: Wolfbox Electric Air Duster MF50 $38.15, DF60 $36.03, MF70 $45.22, DF100 $58.39, DF200 $75.99 Delivered @ Wolfbox eBay

[Avi0001] MF70 is available from last so many months.
[Clear] 500mAh more battery. Now there's a Wolfbox MF400 on Amazon US being advertised as a leaf blower. While it does have the same 72.40 m/s wind speed as the MF50/60/70 disappointingly, it does offer a much larger size with a 15,000mAh battery.
[teereb] Oh man that's pretty cool.
I still have a 20 year old ozito corded least blower… Which is noisy as, but still works a treat.
[NevC] Check for recalls on your model. You may get a free one to replace it.
[NevC] @NevC: https://www.productsafety.gov.au/system/files/recall/Recall%…
[teereb] @NevC: Appreciate the link and information. Mine is from year ~2000. It is ooold haha.
I was wrong, its a Ryobi too. RESV-1600. Just googled it, few going on gumtree in Aus too. Crazy. Does the job for me still.
[bogak] a corded blower, the 200 heats up pretty quick if you use the highest setting and just eats the battery in about 5 minutes.
[Darkscythe] I got the DF200 (Black version of the MF200) and it's been good so far. It's a bit bulkier than the others but the replaceable battery was a selling point for me.
[crazycat] which for general electronics dusting? computers, playstations etc
[PeppaPigDidNthngWrng] any / all of them, but maybe the 100 or 200 would be best (same same, but removable battery)
[guidedlight] Don’t you need a water trap for electronics?
Do these include a water trap feature?
[zenturio] Its not compressed air. Its a tiny fast fan.
[Ehty] I broke the main attachment , any replacements ?
[kzrocky] Thanks ordered the DF200 but price was $94.99
[beefsandwich] You gotta apply the voucher and then go all the way to checkout, and even then scroll to the bottom of the page to see it at $75
[Paokara1] What's a few good real like use case for these. Feedback would be welcomed.
[zenturio] I park under a jaccaranda tree near work. I blow the tiny leaves out of the drainage channels and other crevices on my car. Its just 1 minute after work if there is a lot of mess. For this application its better than a garden leaf blower (which would also be too big).
[ThiftyCent] Is the DF60 any good? Anyone who has one that can vouch?
[kelssy11] Can this be used to dry car after the wash?
[guidedlight] I think it would take a very long time to do that, and the battery would run out long before the car was dry.
[zonra] Not a chance, I use it to blow water out of toothbrush heads and shaver and by the time I’m done it’s down 1 battery bar (out of 4).
You’ll be lucky to do the windshield with it.
[SydShopCat] The comparison table is bizarre. I can barely see any good reason to get anything but the MF50.
